card.name: End of a measure or unit phrase
card.fires_on: The last word of a quantity or unit phrase, such as 'per square mile', 'working days', 'mg/kg' or '°C', and the bracket or comma that follows it. It fires where the measure is complete and a converted value or continuation comes next.

modes.description: A dose or measurement unit is followed by an opening parenthesis or comma that introduces an alternative value or the next clause.
